notes.title: Weekly Run unlocked!
notes.content:
Weekly Challenge Mode
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871589/d6fddd2afcd15fda5a3d1fbae98690c587d22183.jpg"]

Explore the dungeon under new conditions that change every week! Weekly Challenge Mode updates every Tuesday at 9 AM (KST).

Weekly Challenge Mode unlocks once you defeat at least one boss.


New NPCs
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871589/86065cf3a9fcd8109be586cde78b045400849330.jpg"]

Meet the Skill Master to learn new skills—though you’ll need to pay a small fee.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871589/9dce0fdd4f675ad2291b63a09507dbaa0f3606ac.jpg"]

At the House of Sharing, you can donate Hearts or Armor in exchange for Gold.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871589/2c00f6599a8fbfa1701c7a64b0bc2d502b797838.jpg"]

Encounter the Ancient Being, who makes mysterious offers. Perhaps something good will come of it…


Item Additions & Changes
\[Added] Shadow Shield – Increases max Armor based on the number of cursed items equipped.

\[Updated] Poison Knife – On a successful critical hit, applies poison to a slot. Monsters in poisoned slots take damage whenever the character moves.

\[Updated] Toy Hammer – Spinning a monster slot locks that slot. Hitting a locked monster slot may reduce the monster’s attack damage, depending on chance.


Other
You can now view unlock conditions in the character selection screen.

In the Village – Library, you can find more detailed information about each monster.


Next Update Preview
Various weapon additions and adjustments – each weapon will bring new gameplay patterns.

New playable characters – two new characters are still in development. Please look forward to them!


Join Discord!
Share your thoughts with us on the RP7 Discord!
By joining, you’ll be able to try out update builds earlier.

notes.title: Contents update: April 2025
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone playing RP7!
This update focuses on skills that help your character grow stronger. We hope it brings you more joy in building up your character.

New Contents

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871589/9c29965e50e0d27661f71328a7632da5271883b6.gif
Graves
Sometimes you'll find the graves of fallen adventurers in the dungeon. If you like, you can try digging them up. Who knows what you'll find?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871589/72dd6d6675df4113f46dc6a1c05a84fd6787ed78.gif
Poison Spike Trap
A new kind of spike trap has been added. It doesn’t deal damage directly, but the spikes are coated in poison, causing damage over time to your ❤️ for 5 movement turns.

Chest System Changes
After defeating a boss, a skill chest will now always appear. Former boss item chests now appear in the field. They contain high-grade items but cost more than regular item chests.

New Skills

Auto Recovery
Recovers ❤️ by 1 every time you move. While this skill is equipped, potions will no longer appear in slots.

Bounty Boost
Monsters drop more gold.

Bonus Shield
If you spend 200G or more at once, a one-time shield is activated.

Item Updates

Golden Key rework
Now, when equipped, item chests are opened with keys instead of gold. Spin the slots to collect keys!

Credit Card update
This item can now be upgraded.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871589/61fedf495e2db7b82e3cac8b4217071db8f0248c.gif
Zap Gun added
When you equip Zap Gun, the gun may now appear in slots. When obtained, it randomly zaps monsters with a jolt of electricity.

Dice and Anti-Monster items have been turned into character skills.

Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where you took no damage when fighting a pickpocket.
Fixed several bugs related to playing as the Ninja.
Other minor bug fixes.

Other

Some new level data has been added to create more varied monster combinations in the dungeon.

A new character, Necromancer, was planned but got removed because they weren’t fun.

The development of a new character, Ranger, is almost finished. Look forward to them in the next update!

Discord

Join RP7 Discord for early access to updates!

notes.title: Contents Update: Feb. 2025
notes.content:
1. New Enemies Added
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871589/dce3e19af16a052b005e9a0614538283c98ae39e.png

 NEW Upgrade Coupon: Items in chests will now appear at level 2 or higher when you have this coupon.
 Stimpack Adjusted: Increased critical hit chance boost when poisoned.
 Blood Shield Fixed: Fixed a bug where it didn’t work with the "Plague Doctor" character.
 Money Bag Adjusted: When obtained from a chest, it now grants gold equal to the chest's opening cost.
 Zombie’s Blood Adjusted: The item now disappears after activation.
 Wooden Sword Adjusted: Added an upgrade tree.
 Atropine Fixed: Fixed a bug where the item sometimes failed to activate.
 Blood Sword Adjusted: Now restores hearts 100% of the time when landing a critical hit.


3. Other Fixes & Improvements
Minor bug fixes and UI improvements.

4. Next Update Preview
A new game mode and new playable character are in development. Stay tuned!

Join RP7 Discord for early access to updates!
Happy New Year! 🎉

notes.title: New Playable Character: Bull Knight
notes.content:
1. New Playable Character: Bull Knight
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871589/622af9cd43b9043aae7add86fa5cb342b188d752.gif

"A bull only charges forward!"

The Bull Knight cannot spin slots while moving.
When turning at the edge slots, you gain 7 spins, which accumulate if unused.
Starts with the Gold Shield, which activates only when no armor is equipped.

Tips: The Gold Shield automatically activates when you have no armor, so manage your armor wisely.
Tip: Earning money to ensure the Gold Shield activates in emergencies is key to survival.

2. New NPC: Priest
The Priest, a devotee of Mother Turtle, treats all beings as turtles.
The Priest accepts donations to lift curses from items.

3. New Item: Shadow Blade
Your critical chance increases based on the number of cursed items equipped.
It pairs well with the Dark Grimoire.

4. Christmas Update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871589/c009faaeddfdac74f922410e808bd1ebed58a679.jpg
Until December 31, player characters will have Christmas-themed skins!
Meet certain conditions to receive Santa’s Gift: What could you do to ensure Santa leaves a present?

5. Other Updates
Various item bugs and interface elements have been fixed.

Wishing you all a joyful holiday season!
Join the discussion on the RP7 Discord! Discord users gain early access to updates.

notes.title: Contents Update: Nov. 2024
notes.content:
Are you enjoying RP7?
With the last update, there was a major change to the gameplay style, and we hope it’s made the game even more fun.

---

1. New Items Added

Equipment: Advanced Skillbook
- If you have this book, a skill chest will appear instead of an item chest after a boss fight.

Equipment: Balance Stick
- Increases critical hit chance when hearts and armor are equal.

Equipment: Sword of Growth
- Each time you open a chest, critical hit rate increases, and each time you skip opening one, critical hit rate decreases.

Equipment: Club T-shirt
- Increases the chance of shields appearing when spinning multiple slots simultaneously.

Equipment: Radar
- Lowers the appearance rate of monsters in the slot being spun.

Equipment: Dark Grimoire
- When you have this book, a cursed chest will appear instead of an item chest.

Skill: Random Blessing
- Swaps the max values of hearts and armor.

2. Boss Fight Improvements
We’ve adjusted the difficulty for the Griffin and Plague Doctor bosses, as they received feedback about being too challenging. Now, the damage of each boss varies based on the stage they appear in.

3. Object Appearance Rate Improvements
Some probability tweaks have been added in-game. Hopefully, you’ll find yourself thinking, “Why does the same thing keep appearing?!” a little less often.

4. Other
Kickstarter backers who requested name changes have had their supporter names updated!
Various bug fixes, error corrections, and UI improvements.

---

Moving forward, new content updates are expected about once every 1–2 months during the early access period, with intermittent updates focused on bug fixes and gameplay improvements in between.

Join us on the RP7 Discord to share your thoughts!

notes.title: Update 241026
notes.content:
RP7 has had a small but significant change.

While the gameplay that challenges both physical and brainy skill is fun, we’ve noticed many players find it a bit tiring. Originally, we were planning to add the new ‘Bull Knight’ character to allow for a more relaxed playstyle. However, we decided it would be better to make this change a fundamental feature of the player character's behavior.

Now, when the character reaches the slot at either end and changes direction, they will stop moving. After this, you’ll have the opportunity to spin any three slots of your choice, and once that’s done, the character will start moving again.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871589/cdc3d3abeb17dc0d01274cbbf09e0177ba4701e1.gif

This new feature allows players to take a breather, making it easier to assess the current game situation and plan more strategically. We hope this update makes the game easier and even more enjoyable.


[Other Updates]

  Adjusted difficulty for certain bosses and stages.  Fixed some text and texture size errors.

notes.title: Update 241014
notes.content:
Game Data Save
The data-saving feature has been improved. Now, game data will be saved when you reach game over & village, start each stage, and visit the shop after defeating a boss.

Rainbow Slime Boss Adjustment
The Rainbow Slime Boss’s base damage has been increased, but the spins required to lower its damage have been reduced a lot. The boss is now stronger, but you can weaken it more quickly.

Interface Improvements
To improve understanding, the game will now temporarily pause when signs appear at certain points. Additionally, various interface elements that interfered with gameplay have been adjusted.

Sacrifice Rewards Added

https://presskit.turtle-cream.com/games/rp7/images/reward.gif
After defeating a boss, you can make sacrifices to receive rewards. Each item has a specific reward, so plan your sacrifices strategically!

Halloween Update: Pumpkin Potion

https://presskit.turtle-cream.com/games/rp7/images/pumpkin.gif
Until November 1st (GMT), Pumpkin Potions will appear in slots. Drinking a Pumpkin Potion causes ❤️ damage but restores 🔷 by 2. Player titles and Steam achievements related to the Pumpkin Potion have been added—enjoy Halloween!

notes.title: Update 240924
notes.content:
Added Exit Menu: 
We have added the exit menu to areas where it was previously missing, such as in the village and character selection.

Level Design Adjustment: 
We have adjusted the appearance probability of some objects in certain levels.

Sound Bug Fix: 
Fixed an issue where sound volume could not be adjusted in certain situations.

Game data save:
he game data is now saved at the village point. 
We are currently working on saving the data related to stage progress.

notes.title: Update 240920
notes.content:
1. Dice Upgrade:
We have reduced the overpowering effect of the dice and made it upgradeable.

2. Stimpack Upgrade:
You can now upgrade the Stimpack to make its effects stronger.

3. Cheese Updated:
Cheese no longer replaces potions and shields. Instead, you can upgrade it to enhance its effect.

4. Campfire Added to the Village:
You can change your character at the campfire.
When changing the character in the village, gold is carried over, but items are not.

https://presskit.turtle-cream.com/games/rp7/images/campfire.gif

notes.title: Update 240918
notes.content:
[Content Changes]

1. Cat's Paw Upgrade Tree Added:
You can now upgrade the Cat's Paw to gradually increase the critical hit chance against rat-type monsters.

2. Glue Upgrade Tree Added:
The very powerful effect of Glue has been nerfed, but it can now be upgraded.

3. Carousel Upgrade Tree Added:
By upgrading the Carousel, shields and potions will start appearing on the Carousel.

4. Rapier Upgrade Tree Added:
You can now upgrade the Rapier to increase the critical hit rate with consecutive battles against the same monster.

5. Stopwatch Upgrade Tree Adjusted:
The Stopwatch can be upgraded to increase item activation time and adjust the conditions for item activation.

6. Ruby Upgrade Tree Adjusted:
Upgrading the Ruby increases the damage it takes, but reduces damage from other monsters.

7. Toy Hammer Upgrade Tree Adjusted:
Through upgrades, you can increase the item activation chance or reduce monster damage with the Toy Hammer.

8. Game Speed Adjustment Menu Added:
You can now adjust the game speed in the pause menu by pressing ESC.

Other improvements include UI enhancements, and we’ve fixed bugs that were causing sudden game crashes.

notes.title: Update 240917
notes.content:
Thank you for playing RP7!
Please check out the following updates:

[Contents Update]

Potion Bag Typo Fixed:
When the potion bag activates, it spawns a potion in a random position. The previous description incorrectly stated that "the stocked potion is used automatically." This has been corrected.

Cheese Upgrade:
Cheese can now be upgraded! At the final upgrade, it becomes even more effective.

Invisible Cloak Upgrade:
By upgrading the cloak, you can now avoid poison bottles as well.

Neutralizer Upgrade:
The overly powerful effect has been nerfed, but the Neutralizer is now upgradable.

[Next Minor Update]

We've received a lot of feedback regarding game data saving. While it’s difficult to save the game in real time with every movement, we’re planning to save the data at least at the beginning of each stage.

Campfire in the Village:
A campfire is coming to the village! You will be able to change your player character here.

We're continuing to make non-upgradable items upgradable.

notes.title: RP7 Early Access Now Available!
notes.content:
🐸Brave knights, greetings!
After 7 years of conceptualization and development, RP7: Spin Your Own Encounter has finally opened its early access mode today!
If you're enjoying RP7, don't forget to leave a review to support us. Every review is incredibly valuable! 

Trailer
https://youtu.be/9ipv5zc-A5Q?si=cwCB6aaK9p7rgOyG

Price
RP7: Spin Your Own Encounter is priced at $14.99USD, with an 20% discount in the first two weeks.
Additionally, the game will offer a $3.99USD soundtrack, as well as a game and soundtrack bundle, with a 10% discount on the bundle price.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871589/d9dcc1447862da303d6dfeb023ccfb17340d74d1.png

Early Access Content

 3 playable characters: Frog Knight, Plague Doctor, and Ninja.
 5 out of 7 levels.
 Approximately 120 items and skills.
 30 monsters.
 10 bosses.

Upcoming Updates
RP7: Spin Your Own Encounter will continue to be updated for a year, with a unique playable character added every three months, along with more items, monsters, and boss battles!

Special preview: The "Bull Knight" with a distinct turn-based gameplay is coming soon, stay tuned!

https://presskit.turtle-cream.com/games/rp7/images/bullknight.gif

Release Q&A

 How many languages will the game support?
RP7 currently supports English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese. Soon, we will add French, German, Spanish, and Russian.
 Which controllers does the game support?
RP7 currently supports Xbox controllers.
 What's included in the soundtrack?
Upon release, the soundtrack will feature four tracks for the Cave, Grassland, Desert, and Underwater levels. Additionally, we’re working on remixes for these tracks, which will be released soon, along with two remixes of a brand-new boss battle theme. In total, the soundtrack will have 10 tracks.
 Will more game modes be added?
We will consider adding endless mode and daily challenge mode based on the game's development progress.


Finally, thank you all for your attention to RP7. It is you who have made this strange game a reality.
Have a great adventure!

 Item library: Player can check how many locked items are

Your waiting is over. RP7 will be out as Early Access this Summer!

notes.title: Steam Playtest: Summer 2023
notes.content:
Playtest for Summer 2023 has started. You can try RP7's latest demo until September 4th!
Following are the contents of this demo build. Please enjoy the demo and feel free to talk about what you think the game is! 

- 2 playable levels: Each level generated randomly among 15 pre-designed levels and 6 bosses
- 2 playable characters
- Village: Died with a lot of golds? You can upgrade yourself at the village before your next adventure!
- 80 unique items
